purpose: A second, document-specific 30-question calibration and quality check. These questions are distinct from the initial 20-question Avengers: Doomsday calibration fixture and from the synthetic held-out evaluation dataset.

questions.question: How long after the events of Thunderbolts* (2025) does Avengers: Doomsday take place?
questions.expected_answer: Fourteen months after Thunderbolts* (2025).

questions.question: According to Kevin Feige, is Doctor Doom an alternate-universe variant of Tony Stark?
questions.expected_answer: No. Feige said Doom is not an alternate-universe variant of Tony Stark / Iron Man.

questions.question: How did Robert Downey Jr. describe Doctor Doom's approach?
questions.expected_answer: Downey described Doom as a master manipulator who is willing to go scorched earth.

questions.question: Which comic-book Secret Wars stories inspired the Russo brothers' interest in directing a Secret Wars film?
questions.expected_answer: The 1984–85 crossover event written by Jim Shooter and the 2015–16 storyline written by Jonathan Hickman; both bring Marvel characters together on Battleworld.

questions.question: What comic-book storyline inspired The Kang Dynasty, and what does Kang do in it?
questions.expected_answer: A 2001–02 storyline written by Kurt Busiek, in which Kang the Conqueror travels through time to enslave humanity.

questions.question: What release dates were initially announced for The Kang Dynasty and Avengers: Secret Wars in July 2022?
questions.expected_answer: May 2, 2025, for The Kang Dynasty and November 7, 2025, for Secret Wars.

questions.question: Who was originally hired to direct The Kang Dynasty?
questions.expected_answer: Destin Daniel Cretton.

questions.question: How many cast members did Marvel announce for the film in March 2025 alongside Robert Downey Jr.?
questions.expected_answer: Twenty-six cast members.

questions.question: Why did Disney and Marvel Studios fire Jonathan Majors in December 2023, according to the article?
questions.expected_answer: He was found guilty of harassment and reckless assault in the third degree.

questions.question: When and where did principal photography begin?
questions.expected_answer: April 28, 2025, at Pinewood Studios in Buckinghamshire, England.

questions.question: Which studio in Berkshire also hosted filming?
questions.expected_answer: Shinfield Studios.

questions.question: Who plays Thor, and what is Thor's role among the Avengers?
questions.expected_answer: Chris Hemsworth plays Thor, the Asgardian god of thunder and a founding Avenger.

questions.question: Who plays Yelena Belova, and which team is she a member of?
questions.expected_answer: Florence Pugh plays Yelena Belova, a member of the New Avengers.

questions.question: Who plays Sam Wilson, and what equipment did the military train him to use in aerial combat?
questions.expected_answer: Anthony Mackie plays Sam Wilson. He was trained to use a specially designed wing pack.

questions.question: Who plays Bucky Barnes, and what is his position in the New Avengers?
questions.expected_answer: Sebastian Stan plays Bucky Barnes / Winter Soldier, the de facto leader of the New Avengers.

questions.question: What is the name of Sentry's dark alter ego?
questions.expected_answer: The Void.

questions.question: Who plays Cyclops, and how does the character control his optic energy beams?
questions.expected_answer: James Marsden plays Cyclops, who controls his optic energy beams with a special visor.

questions.question: How long did Alan Cumming's Nightcrawler makeup take for Doomsday compared with X2?
questions.expected_answer: About an hour and a half for Doomsday, compared with four and a half to five hours for X2.

questions.question: Why did Disney delay the film's release date in May 2025?
questions.expected_answer: To allow more time for production to be completed.

questions.question: Who is editing the film?
questions.expected_answer: Jeffrey Ford and Matthew Schmidt.

questions.question: Which actor portrays Franklin Richards?
questions.expected_answer: The article names Franklin Richards as a character but does not identify the actor portraying him.

questions.question: Which actor voices H.E.R.B.I.E. in the film?
questions.expected_answer: The article mentions H.E.R.B.I.E. but does not identify a voice actor.

questions.question: What are the names of the three Latverian witches?
questions.expected_answer: The article describes three masked Latverian witches but does not give their names.

questions.question: How many actors are in the film's complete final cast?
questions.expected_answer: The article says the full cast had not yet been announced, so it does not give the final cast total.

questions.question: How much was Robert Downey Jr. paid to play Doctor Doom?
questions.expected_answer: The article does not state Downey's compensation.

questions.question: On what date was the first official trailer released?
questions.expected_answer: The article does not state a first-trailer release date.

questions.question: In which city in Bahrain did location filming take place?
questions.expected_answer: The article mentions location filming in Bahrain but does not name a city.

questions.question: Exactly how many actors from the 20th Century Fox X-Men films appear in Doomsday?
questions.expected_answer: The article says some actors from Fox's X-Men films appear but does not give an exact count.

questions.question: What is the film's production budget?
questions.expected_answer: The article does not state the production budget.

questions.question: Which of the Latverian witches leads Doom's coven?
questions.expected_answer: The article says the three witches act as Doom's coven but does not identify a leader.
